resources.string: Describe one or multiple transactions (expenses or incomes). Review the result, then save when everything looks right.
When you tap Parse with AI, this sentence, your category list, and the device date and time zone are sent to Claude (Anthropic) for processing.
No wallets yet. Go back and add one from the Wallet tab before saving a transaction.
Categories are unavailable. Reload or reopen this page.
AI results can be incorrect. Every field is editable, and no transaction has been saved yet.
Use whole rupiah without separators, for example 25000.
Use yyyy-MM-dd. Relative dates use the device time.
This marker is saved with this transaction. Future transactions and reminders are not created automatically.
Enter an amount greater than 0, a valid date (yyyy-MM-dd), a category, and a wallet. Merchant allows up to 200 characters and note up to 1000.
AI has not been configured in this app version. You can still enter the transaction manually.
Unable to connect to the internet. Check your connection and parse again, or enter the transaction manually.
Claude took too long to respond. Parse again or enter the transaction manually.
The AI request limit has been reached. Try again shortly or enter the transaction manually.
Claude access was denied. The AI access configuration needs to be checked. You can still enter the transaction manually.
The AI service is unavailable. Try again later or enter the transaction manually.
The AI result could not be read or did not match the transaction format and available categories. Clarify the sentence and parse again, or enter the transaction manually.
Describe transactions with a clear amount, using at most 1000 characters.
Categories or wallets could not be loaded. Reload to continue.
The transaction could not be saved. Check the fields and wallet, then tap Confirm & save again.

AI features are optional and require an internet connection. Add with AI sends your typed sentence, category list, and device date and time zone to Claude (Anthropic). AI Chat sends your typed question, up to six latest completed conversation pairs, and aggregate spending summaries for all wallets covering the current week, current month, and previous month. The summary includes totals and categories plus time, time zone, and currency metadata; raw transactions, merchant or note details, and wallet card metadata are not added to chat requests. Chat history is kept only while the chat navigation entry remains active and is not stored in the database. Review AI results before using them. Manual entry remains available without AI processing.
Text and categories are securely processed only to parse this transaction.
